claims.statement: For each original leaf tag v, I(T-v,z)=I(H_v,z)+zI(R_v,z), the favorable selector is the coefficient q_(p+1)-q_p+r_(p+1)-r_(p-1)<0, and the selected summand is q_p-q_(p-1). This is a correct per-leaf reformulation. The selector alone does not determine the summand or its selected global sum; this coefficient-comparison route needs a separate selector-aware bridge. Chudnovsky–Seymour real-rootedness does not apply uniformly to arbitrary trees and does not establish that bridge.
